caption: The drawing depicts an interior room furnished with various pieces of furniture and decorated elements. In the foreground, there are three armchairs; one is wooden with a plaid blanket draped over the back, another is an ornate black leather chair with carved wooden arms, and the third has a floral cushion and a curved wood design. A wooden coffee table sits in the center, bearing a green gift box, several books, a pink potted flower, and a tea set. Against the back wall, there is a red upholstered armchair, and nearby is a wooden fireplace with a brick surround, a dark fireplace grate, and green-shaded wall sconces above. Two large pillars with ornate decorative capitals frame the seating area, and a Tiffany-style stained glass lamp with shades of green and yellow is positioned on the coffee table. Hanging from the wooden beamed ceiling are green glass pendant lamps, some with brass fittings. The carpet is patterned in shades of blue, green, and brown, covering much of the floor. The walls are partially paneled with dark wood wainscoting, and there are paintings in gilded frames. An open doorway at the rear labeled "DINING ROOM THE STARS" leads into another room set with white-clothed round tables and wooden chairs, and several glass pendant lamps hang from the ceiling. Additional small decor items, such as a ceramic pot with green foliage, a white doily, and more books, are scattered throughout the scene. The overall color scheme features earthy, muted tones of brown, green, red, and blue, with accents of brass and stained glass.
title: Hollywood Hotel Lobby, 1902
